entries.title: Thank you to dang and sctb
entries.author: sama
entries.current_title: Thank you to dang and sctb
entries.excerpt: Dan and Scott do an incredible amount of work behind the scenes to make Hacker News what it is. I have never met two more thoughtful community stewards. They usually get more hate than thanks, which they deal with cheerfully. This community means a lot to a lot of people. So today I wanted to say thanks, on behalf of the HN community.
entries.guide_zh: 一位社区成员感谢 dang 与 sctb 在幕后维护 HN 的辛勤工作。

entries.title: Tell HN: Amazon now owns 3.0.0.0/8
entries.author: STRML
entries.excerpt: Apparently bought in two chunks: 3.0.0.0/9 and 3.128.0.0/9. Previous owner was GE. Anecdotal reports across the Internet that AWS EIPs are now being assigned in that range. https://whois.arin.net/rest/net/NET-3-0-0-0-1.html https://whois.arin.net/rest/net/NET-3-128-0-0-1.html
entries.guide_zh: 作者注意到亚马逊获得原属 GE 的 3.0.0.0/8 地址段，讨论地址归属变化。

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (November 2018)
entries.author: whoishiring
entries.excerpt: Please state the job location and include the keywords REMOTE, INTERNS and/or VISA when the corresponding sort of candidate is welcome. When remote work is not an option, include ONSITE. Please only post if you personally are part of the hiring company—no recruiting firms or job boards. Only one post per company, please. If it isn't a household name, explain what your company does. Commenters: please don't reply to job posts to complain about something. It's off topic here. R
entries.guide_zh: 十一月招聘信息交流，请明确工作位置与远程、实习、签证支持。

entries.title: Ask HN: What are some hacks of real founders who did things that don't scale?
entries.author: trulykp
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What are some hacks of real founders who did things that don't scale?
entries.excerpt: Inspired by Paul Graham's phrase, I’m curating an open list of hacks/stories of real founders who did “things that don’t scale” to power through their initial startup days. What are some of the hacks you have heard or have personally experimented? Thank you in advance!
entries.guide_zh: 征集创始人亲自做“不易规模化的事”来渡过早期难关的真实故事。

entries.title: Ask HN: Anyone else find the new Gmail interface sluggish?
entries.author: aerovistae
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Anyone else find the new Gmail interface sluggish?
entries.excerpt: For me it's so unresponsive that I'm at a loss for words how google put this into production. I have a modern, new computer and modern, urban internet good enough for streaming 1080p on Twitch without interruption, but I can't delete or archive an email anymore without waiting 4-6 seconds for it to complete the action. What has your experience been like with it? edit: Guess I'm not alone. I can only hope someone working at Google sees this post or cares. Maybe too much to hop
entries.guide_zh: 新版 Gmail 是否让你觉得反应迟钝，现代电脑和网络下也一样吗？
